description: Fixed constraints baked into the M365 relay OBO image: the default Graph scope list (operators override it with MS365_MCP_ALLOWED_SCOPES; the tool surface is derived from the scopes at every start by Softeria's --allowed-scopes logic), the tools excluded because the relay provides a better replacement (download-bytes* → get-download-url), the attachment-bridge primitives hidden because get-attachment-upload-link replaces them, and the safety switches (not weakenable through the environment). Nothing is withheld for any other reason: what an organisation does not want is Blocked in Claude's per-tool permissions.
